title: Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan
attributionNote: The Sefaria catalogue records this as a composite or traditionally transmitted work. Authorship is not asserted here beyond the source's own metadata.
description: Chol HaMoed (the intermediate days of Passover and Sukkot), mourning and ex-communication. Complete Talmud text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: The Jerusalem Talmud is a separate rabbinic compilation from the Babylonian Talmud, shaped by the academies of the Land of Israel.
